SOUTH LAREDO, Texas — Two people were injured in a shooting Wednesday evening in south Laredo, according to KGNS, following an earlier report that put at least one person hurt in the same incident.

According to the Laredo Morning Times, the shooting was reported by the Laredo Police Department at about 6:37 p.m. on Wednesday, Oct. 21, near New York Avenue and Tinaja Street. Police closed the intersection of New York Avenue and Chacota Street in connection with the shooting. Details were still preliminary, and the situation was still developing when the initial report was published.

KGNS reported Oct. 22 that Laredo police said two people were injured in the South New York shooting, updating the victim count from the initial report of at least one injured person.

Police had not released further details, including information about possible suspects, as of the latest reports. Webb Watch 956 will update this story as more information becomes available.

Sources:

  • Laredo Morning Times: “Shooting in south Laredo leaves at least one injured” (Oct. 21, 2026)
  • KGNS: “Laredo police report 2 injured in South New York shooting” (Oct. 22, 2026)

Webb Watch 956
excerpt: Laredo police reported two people injured in a shooting Wednesday evening near New York Avenue and Tinaja Street in south Laredo; details remained preliminary as the investigation continued.
title: Two injured in south Laredo shooting near New York Avenue, police say
